# Bettercap

`bettercap` &middot; _wireless-attacks_

A modular framework for network, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth reconnaissance and attacks.

**High impact.** This tool can disrupt a target or a network. Confirm scope first.

## What this tool needs

- A network interface you are authorised to use.
- Root and (for wireless) monitor-mode capable hardware.

## How to use it

Bettercap has an interactive shell and web UI. Use it for ARP spoofing, sniffing and Wi-Fi discovery on a lab network you own. Never on a network you are not authorised to test.

## Examples

```console
$ bettercap -iface eth0
$ bettercap -eval 'net.probe on; net.show'
```
